history.summary: A 393-unit leasehold literally on top of Kovan MRT (350m) at $1,672 psf — ~12.5% below the URA median ($1,911) — combining excellent transit access, a compact efficient 2BR and good liquidity. The entry below median plus best-in-batch MRT proximity makes this an attractive value play despite mixed management reviews.
history.rating_rationale: 646sqft 2BR at $1.08M / $1,672 psf is ~12.5% under median PSF ($1,911) with 86 transactions and a 4.96% CAGR. 350m to Kovan NE13 (4min) is the standout transit access in the batch, underpinning both resale and a broad tenant pool along the NEL. 393 units give adequate liquidity. Off-frontier technically (MMR 1546 / score 781) but the location-plus-discount fundamentals are strong. Mixed management/maintenance reviews are a watch-item, not a dealbreaker.
red_flags: Mixed reviews on management office and build/window quality
catalysts: 350m / 4min to Kovan NE13 MRT — best transit access in the batch
NEL connectivity supports deep tenant demand
